purpose: Verified provenance for UI libraries, source reuse and behavioral references. This manifest does not imply integration.

source_entries.name: CADCraft upstream
source_entries.decision: Reuse actual checked-in CADCraft UI and command functions. Provenance inherited from existing fork; specific upstream base commit should be audited before further vendoring.

source_entries.name: GIMP application core
source_entries.decision: Eligible for source integration after precise file and copyleft/GTK compatibility review; currently GIMP-inspired persistent docks, dockbooks, tool options and contextual command UX only.

source_entries.name: GIMP libgimp
source_entries.decision: Library integration candidate for image workflows. GIMP declares a separately LGPL-licensed libgimp interface and a procedural database exception; no direct source integration yet.

source_entries.name: GIMP icon/themes/assets
source_entries.license: CC BY-SA 3.0/4.0 and individually licensed assets
source_entries.decision: Do not copy icon themes, fonts or bundled imagery until individual licenses and asset attribution are reviewed. Prefer Worldwright originals.

source_entries.name: Tenzen Photon Studio desktop editor
source_entries.decision: Free app and donation model, but no verified open-source desktop code grant. Familiar command search, layer/mask workflows and panels are behavioral inspiration only; copying application code is NOT authorized.

source_entries.name: PhotonStudio website (not desktop app)
source_entries.decision: Separate public website repository. MIT on website assets or code does not license Tenzen's photo editor or establish shared ownership.

copy_requirements.distribution: Review combined work, corresponding source, license texts, local modifications and attribution on every packaged release.
